forms.label: Standard
forms.animalOriginNote: Giffard, the reference producer, states its Crème de Violette is vegan, lactose-free and made from natural violet flavouring with no animal-derived ingredient.
forms.sourceNote: Giffard is taken as the reference producer - the bottle most modern recipes assume - and states 16% alc./vol. No sugar or energy figure is published, so sugarGPer100 and nutritionPer100g are left off rather than estimated; this Form's composition understates the liqueur's real sweetness. Density has no measured source and is taken from the density-classes.json 'liqueur-sweet' class.
